mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3 percentage points over three months signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by > 0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.0% annualized), the S&P 500 delivers positive returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO growth rate > 1.0% (annualized).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) reflects a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of months when PAYEMS is above the 5-year average.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal a strong economic expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST increases by > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases by > 0.3pp in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (2017=100) indicates economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0.
